messages:
maya: Quick question — how do we expect fallback ordering + notify rate cap to interact when a tenant hits rate limits and primary model returns 429s? I think there may be a gap where fallback kicks and also we double-notify SREs.
cheng: Do you mean the per-tenant notify rate cap (notify_rate_limit_per_min) or the global fanout cap? @maya
maya: per-tenant + default fanout. Example: rule triggers, we fanout to 3 contacts but tenant cap prevents sending more than 1 per minute.
kevin: We currently apply rate caps post-fanout selection. So contacts are chosen, then we filter by cap. That means fallback priority might be wasted on contacts suppressed by cap.
alex: That seems wrong for canary -> prod fallback. Want deterministic ordering: pick first contact not rate-limited and send. If all are capped, queue or silence based on policy.
cheng: Agreed. Suggested approach: evaluation order = (policy fallback priority) -> apply per-contact rate cap check -> if all capped follow 'on_all_capped' policy (suppress / escalate to backup channel / emit metric).
maya: Can we update API contract for notify selection? Current API is: POST /notify/evaluate with {rule_id, tenant_id} and returns list of contacts. We need it to also indicate which contacts were skipped due to rate cap and why.
kevin: Minimal change: return contacts plus metadata array: [{contact_id, selected: bool, reason: "rate_limited"|"ok"}]. That keeps clients simple.
alex: Also need a console signal: show in the rule's history UI when notifies were suppressed. Customers keep asking "why didn't my on-call get paged?"
maya: UX asks: show suppressed count and suggested next-action (retry time). Could be small badge in timeline.
cheng: Implementation note: metrics: counter notify.suppressed{reason,tenant,rule} and gauge notify.queue_length. rollout-bot: rollout scheduled: feature flag slo_notify_ratecap_metadata rollout 10% -> 100% over 48h.
maya: Ok I'll file a tiny RFC. Any objections to the metadata shape? If none I'll open API PR.
kevin: +1
alex: +1
cheng: +1
maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
